csv_project_name: Consultant for Geotechnical & Construction Material Testing
csv_scope_of_work: The project scope is to collect materials and conduct materials testing during the construction phase of capital improvement projects. Expected testing shall be conducted on the following areas, but not limited to, embankment, flexible base, prime coat, tack coat, seal coat, backfill, flowable backfill, subgrade, HMAC, concrete, and soils. Bore sampling and repairs to restore existing conditions per City standards after the bores are taken will also be part of the testing scope. Earthwork bore sampling capabilities to a depth of at least 50-ft from existing ground are required. The frequency of testing shall be dependent on approved engineering practices specific to each testing procedure used.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Materials Testing, Site Evaluation/Selection, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
